# ClearStack

> Custom websites and web applications for NZ businesses. Designed to work, built to grow.

ClearStack is a web design and development studio based in Auckland, New Zealand. We build custom websites and SaaS applications for small and medium businesses. No templates, no page builders — just clean, fast, purpose-built software.

## Services

- **Website Design & Development**: Custom-designed, research-driven websites built with modern frameworks (React, Next.js). Not Squarespace themes with your logo swapped in.
- **SaaS & Web Applications**: Custom web applications, internal tools, and client portals built to your exact workflow.

## Process

1. **Understand**: We learn your business before touching a screen.
2. **Plan**: Structure, user flows, and technology decisions locked in before code is written.
3. **Build**: Design and development move together with weekly progress.
4. **Grow**: Launch is just the starting line. We track, refine, and add capability as your business evolves.

## Investment

- **Landing Page**: From $1,200 NZD — single-purpose page designed to convert.
- **Business Website**: From $3,500 NZD — up to 6 pages, CMS, SEO, analytics, 3 months post-launch support.
- **Web Application**: Custom scoped — full-stack React/Next.js, auth, API integrations, documentation.
